leadText: Maury (Japanese: カツミ Katsumi) is a minor character who appeared in The Rise of Darkrai.
plainText:
Maury (Japanese: カツミ Katsumi) is a minor character who appeared in The Rise of Darkrai.

==In the movies==
 
He, along with and Allegra, challenged and to a . He went up against Ash using his , while Ash used his , who made a folly by commanding a on Maury's Torterra—likely not realizing it is —and then switched to .

Maury was later invited by Baron Alberto to help fight off .

During the ending credits, Maury participated in the Alamos Town Pokémon Contest, where he was subsequently defeated by Kai in the Battle Stage. He is not onstage when Allegra receives her winning Ribbon.

Maury made a cameo appearance in I Choose You!, which is set in a continuity separate from . He was seen with his Torterra in Alamos Town.

==Trivia==
Maury, , and Allegra each own the final form of one Sinnoh first partner Pokémon.
Though he was not referred to by name in the dub, Pokémon.com has since revealed that his name is Maury.
Maury's character design resembles that of Torterra's color scheme.
Maury was referred to as Maurice on his voice actor's résumé.
